name: Exp_Fractal_ADX_Cloud
summary: This EA trades breakout signals based on the Fractal indicator combined with ADX trend strength filtering and an Ichimoku Cloud confirmation. It enters long when price breaks above a fractal high with ADX confirming trend strength and price above the Cloud, and enters short on the mirror condition. Exits are triggered by opposite signals, ADX weakness, or Cloud penetration.
summary_zh: 该EA基于分形指标突破信号，结合ADX趋势强度过滤和一目均衡云确认进行交易。当价格突破分形高点且ADX确认趋势强度且价格位于云层上方时做多，反之做空。出场由反向信号、ADX走弱或云层穿透触发。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Bill Williams分形突破与ADX趋势强度过滤的双重确认机制。入场条件：做多需价格向上突破最近的上分形、ADX主线值大于阈值（默认25）且+DI大于-DI、价格位于一目均衡云上方；做空需价格向下突破最近的下分形、ADX主线值大于阈值且-DI大于+DI、价格位于云层下方。出场条件包括：触及止损或止盈、ADX主线跌破阈值表示趋势减弱、价格穿越云层方向反转。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可通过参数设定每笔交易的手数。资金管理方面，EA提供止损和止盈参数供用户设置，但没有动态仓位调整或基于账户余额的风险百分比计算功能。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is built on a dual-confirmation mechanism combining Bill Williams Fractal breakouts with ADX trend strength filtering. Entry conditions: a long trade requires price breaking above the most recent upper fractal, ADX main line exceeding a threshold (default 25) with +DI above -DI, and price positioned above the Ichimoku Cloud; a short trade requires price breaking below the most recent lower fractal, ADX above threshold with -DI above +DI, and price below the Cloud. Exit conditions include: hitting stop loss or take profit levels, ADX main line dropping below the threshold indicating trend weakness, or price crossing the Cloud in the opposite direction. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user specifies the trade volume via input parameter. Money management provides configurable stop loss and take profit parameters but lacks dynamic position sizing or risk-percentage calculation based on account equity.

parameters.name: ADX_Threshold
parameters.description: ADX趋势强度阈值，高于此值才开仓
parameters.description_en: ADX trend strength threshold, only open positions above this value

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 中文优势1：分形突破+ADX+云层三重过滤机制有效减少假信号
中文优势2：一目均衡云提供动态支撑阻力位，适应市场波动
中文优势3：ADX过滤确保只在趋势明确时入场，避免震荡市亏损
中文优势4：止损止盈参数化设计，用户可灵活调整风控
pros_en: English strength 1: Triple filter of Fractal breakout + ADX + Ichimoku Cloud significantly reduces false signals
English strength 2: Ichimoku Cloud provides dynamic support/resistance levels that adapt to market volatility
English strength 3: ADX filtering ensures entries only during confirmed trends, avoiding losses in ranging markets
English strength 4: Parameterized stop loss and take profit design allows flexible risk control adjustment
cons: 中文劣势1：固定手数仓位管理不够灵活，未考虑账户风险比例
中文劣势2：分形信号存在滞后性，突破信号可能来得较晚
中文劣势3：缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
中文劣势4：未检测新K线开始，同一根K线内可能重复开仓
cons_en: English weakness 1: Fixed lot position sizing is inflexible and does not account for account risk percentage
English weakness 2: Fractal signals are inherently lagging, breakout signals may arrive late
English weakness 3: No spread filter, potentially leading to unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
English weakness 4: No new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions within the same candle
improvements: 中文改进1：增加基于账户余额百分比的风险仓位计算功能
中文改进2：添加新K线检测逻辑，避免同一根K线重复开仓
improvements_en: English improvement 1: Add risk-based position sizing that calculates lot size as a percentage of account equity
English improvement 2: Add new bar detection logic to prevent duplicate position openings within the same candle

risk_points: 中文风险点1：固定手数不随账户规模调整，大额账户可能过度集中风险
中文风险点2：缺少新K线检测可能导致同一信号反复开仓，增加暴露
risk_points_en: English risk point 1: Fixed lot size does not scale with account size, large accounts may have concentrated risk
English risk point 2: No new bar check may cause repeated position opening on the same signal, increasing exposure
